info.title: API.SH: pixiv
info.description: The pixiv API from API.SH: public pixiv data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One pixiv illustration, manga or animation: title, description, tags with translations, dates, size, views, likes, bookmarks, comments, original flag, AI flag, artist, the image links of every page (thumbnail to original), series and page metadata. R-18 works answer 404 unless `include_nsfw=true`. Image links need the header Referer: https://www.pixiv.net/ to download.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pixiv-artwork

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artwork id or a pixiv.net/artworks/<id> link.

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: Opt in to works marked R-18 / R-18G (each work carries `rating`). Default off. The site's logged-out view rarely includes such works.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: 小説投稿機能をリリースしました
example.description_html:
2010年07月29日 pixivに小説投稿機能を追加しました。
小説投稿機能は、これまでテキスト・小説をイラストとしてアップロードしていた方々や、イラストを書くためのシナリオや、イラストを題材にした小説を投稿したいと考えていた方々に向けた機能です。

get.description:
Illustrations, manga and animations (ugoira) on pixiv for a keyword or tag, with the site's filters: type, tag match mode, newest/oldest, date range, image size, aspect ratio, drawing tool and hiding AI-generated works. Each work: id, title, type, tags, thumbnail, size, page count, AI flag, dates and artist. Also the related tags, tag translations and the popular works for the tag. All-ages works only by default (`include_nsfw=true` opts in); each work carries its `rating`. 60 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pixiv-search

parameters.name: include_nsfw

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
